title: The Auctioneer of the Drowned Market
story: Beneath the lagoon, Nacrelle has locked five merfolk children in bubble-cages and is auctioning the release nets to the highest bidder. Mr 6 arrives with a pouch of moonstone shards and a very sharp pencil. Nacrelle grins and adds her famous 'salt surcharge' to the bill.
question: Each release net costs 48 moonstone shards, and Mr 6 needs 5 of them. Nacrelle adds a 25% salt surcharge to the whole order, then grumpily takes off 40 shards because Mr 6 proved her adding was wrong. How many moonstone shards does Mr 6 pay?
solution: Then take off the 40-shard correction: 300 - 40 = 260 shards.
praise: Handling the surcharge with a percent was strong thinking — the last move was subtracting the 40-shard correction at the end.
hint: First find the price of all five nets, then grow it by 25%, and only subtract the 40 shards at the very end.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 260 shards, and the bubble-cages popped like soap. Nacrelle now recalculates every bill three times, muttering, 'that six was watching.'
imagePrompt: An underwater lagoon market lit by glowing pearls, where a knight-numeral 6 with a blue cape holds up a tally slate to a shimmering eel-tailed auctioneer floating above bubble-cages.
